Through LiDAR technology and AI, we reduce the overall project time of heat pump installations by 50%.

product.name: Heat Pump Check
product.description: A tool for quickly assessing the suitability of a heat pump for a building.

product.name: Customer Portal
product.description: A platform for managing customer communication and project progress related to heat pump installations.

product.name: Quotation Tool
product.description: A software tool that generates precise heat pump installation offers based on high-quality data.

product.name: LiDAR Scan
product.description: A scanning feature using LiDAR and AI to capture building and heating system data for planning heat pump installations.

product.name: Heat Loss Survey
product.description: A software module that calculates room-specific heat loss according to DIN EN 12831 standards.

product.name: Hydraulic Balancing
product.description: A tool to perform hydraulic balancing of heating systems following VdZ procedures to optimize heat distribution.
